title: Buying an apartment as a foreign national in Dushanbe: checks before a deposit
excerpt: First clarify whether acquisition is permitted for your status, location and property; then check documents and payment. This article does not confirm blanket permission for all foreign nationals to buy housing.
contentHtml:
Substantively updated on 15 October 2026.

Start by checking the applicable rules rather than choosing a payment plan. The official Tajik law page on the legal status of foreign citizens and stateless persons contains restrictions and exceptions for residential property. A general claim that all foreigners may buy apartments does not replace checking your circumstances.

First establish whether the particular acquisition is permitted

Before a deposit, ask a notary or lawyer whether statutory exceptions apply to your status, location and selected property. Request the current legal provision and documents supporting the possibility of registration. Keep the official source link and consultation date. An agency article or news about amendments is not individual confirmation of a right to buy.

Clarify the document list beforehand

Obtain the list for your case: identity and residence-status documents, any translation requirement, marital-status information and representative documents if applicable. Do not treat any online checklist as exhaustive or mandatory for everyone. Clarify the apartment, seller and title documents separately.

Check the apartment and agreement

Compare the address, area and designated use with the documents. Clarify registered rights and restrictions, the seller’s authority and the registration process. For construction, check the particular building, developer and agreement. A QR code or attractive presentation alone does not establish permission to buy or performance of future obligations.

Payment and banking questions

Before transferring funds, agree with the bank on an available payment route, fees, exchange rate, source-of-funds evidence and required transaction documents. Do not assume that any international transfer, account opening or mortgage program is automatically available. Confirm availability and timing with the selected bank for your documentation.

Moving on to viewings

Once the legal conditions are clarified, compare budget, location and condition of suitable apartments. Before paying, obtain an agreed transaction process and check the final documents. The ROYAL HOME catalog contains sale offers; an advertisement does not establish every visitor’s right to acquire the property.

Sources and verification

Official source — НЦЗ / National Centre for Legislation. Check the current provision and its application to your circumstances with a notary or appropriate lawyer. The full text on the legal center website did not load during this review; this article does not confirm eligibility for a particular transaction.

faq.q: Can every foreign citizen automatically buy an apartment in Dushanbe?
faq.a: This article does not provide blanket confirmation. Check applicable restrictions and exceptions, your status, the location and property with a notary or appropriate lawyer using current official legislation.

faq.q: Is news about a legal amendment sufficient?
faq.a: No. The current provision and its application to the particular transaction must be checked. Do not pay a deposit based on one publication alone.
